newsitem.title: ST VINCENT: CRICKET-LARA ENDS LEAN SPELL WITH UNBEATEN 88.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-LARA ENDS LEAN SPELL WITH UNBEATEN 88.

text.p: Brian Lara returned to form with an unbeaten 88 as West Indies began to take charge in the second and final test against Sri Lanka on Monday.
Lara spurred West Indies, 75 behind on first innings, to 226 for three in their second innings at lunch on the fourth day -- 151 ahead.
The Trinidadian left-hander shared an unbroken fourth-wicket stand of 83 in 90 minutes with Carl Hooper (26 not out) after West Indies resumed at the overnight 128 for two in the rain-hit match.
Lara emerged from a sequence of three single-figure scores in the short series to stroke nine fours and a six in the morning session after starting the day on 30 which included just one boundary.
Sri Lanka's only success in the first session was the dismissal of Floyd Reifer for 18, caught by wicket-keeper Romesh Kaluwitharana off pace bowler Ravindra Pushpakumara.
Lara completed his half-century in 156 minutes off 102 balls, then accelerated with five more boundaries, and a six off Muttiah Muralitharan's off-spin.
Lara ended the session with a flourish by hitting Muralitharan through the off-side for three fours in the last over before lunch.
